about: Made-up drafts of each kind that held graded packs at 2 of 5 for readability (30 packs, 2026-11-08), each with a version that reads well. Every 'before' must have a finding of its code and every 'after' none at all (tests/test_writing_readability.py). Markers are as the attribution writes them in.
